caption:
You know your project inside out. Then the interviewer asks, and nothing comes.

Interview Sarthi is a Windows app that helps you during the online interview itself: it listens to the call and shows you what to say, drafted from your own resume. Your project, your numbers, your words, while the interview is on.

30 minutes free with every feature, no card. Passes from Rs 99, nothing renews.
